spec.rawSql:
WITH callbacks AS (
  SELECT
    h.id,
    h.created_at,
    h.fulfilled_at,
    h.expires_at,
    CASE
      WHEN h.expires_at <= NOW() THEN 'expired'
      ELSE h.status
    END AS state
  FROM oneoff_hooks h
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM callbacks;

spec.description: All callback rows currently stored (pending, fulfilled, and expired rows awaiting cleanup). Ignores the time range.
spec.title: Total Callbacks

spec.rawSql:
WITH callbacks AS (
  SELECT
    h.id,
    h.created_at,
    h.fulfilled_at,
    h.expires_at,
    CASE
      WHEN h.expires_at <= NOW() THEN 'expired'
      ELSE h.status
    END AS state
  FROM oneoff_hooks h
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM callbacks WHERE state <> 'expired';

spec.description: Callbacks that have not expired yet (pending + fulfilled awaiting retrieval). Ignores the time range.
spec.title: Active Callbacks

spec.description: Rows past expires_at that the background cleanup task has not deleted yet. Ignores the time range.
spec.title: Expired (Awaiting Cleanup)

spec.rawSql:
WITH callbacks AS (
  SELECT
    h.id,
    h.created_at,
    h.fulfilled_at,
    h.expires_at,
    CASE
      WHEN h.expires_at <= NOW() THEN 'expired'
      ELSE h.status
    END AS state
  FROM oneoff_hooks h
)
SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fulfilled_at IS NOT NULL)::double precision / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) AS value
FROM callbacks
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at);

spec.description: Share of callbacks created in the selected time range that have been fulfilled.
spec.title: Fulfillment Rate

spec.rawSql:
WITH callbacks AS (
  SELECT
    h.id,
    h.created_at,
    h.fulfilled_at,
    h.expires_at,
    CASE
      WHEN h.expires_at <= NOW() THEN 'expired'
      ELSE h.status
    END AS state
  FROM oneoff_hooks h
)
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - created_at)), 0) AS value
FROM callbacks
WHERE state <> 'expired';

spec.description: Average age of active (non-expired) callbacks. Ignores the time range.

spec.description: Age of the oldest pending callback. Ignores the time range.

spec.description: Average time between callback creation and fulfillment for callbacks fulfilled in the selected time range.
spec.title: Avg Time to Fulfill

spec.rawSql:
WITH callbacks AS (
  SELECT
    h.id,
    h.created_at,
    h.fulfilled_at,
    h.expires_at,
    CASE
      WHEN h.expires_at <= NOW() THEN 'expired'
      ELSE h.status
    END AS state
  FROM oneoff_hooks h
)
SELECT COALESCE(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM fulfilled_at - created_at)), 0) AS value
FROM callbacks
WHERE fulfilled_at IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(fulfilled_at);

spec.description: 95th percentile time to fulfill for callbacks fulfilled in the selected time range.
spec.title: P95 Time to Fulfill

spec.rawSql:
WITH callbacks AS (
  SELECT
    h.id,
    h.created_at,
    h.fulfilled_at,
    h.expires_at,
    CASE
      WHEN h.expires_at <= NOW() THEN 'expired'
      ELSE h.status
    END AS state
  FROM oneoff_hooks h
)
SELECT COALESCE(MIN(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM expires_at - NOW())), 0) AS value
FROM callbacks
WHERE state <> 'expired';

spec.description: Time until the next active callback expires. Ignores the time range.
spec.title: Next Expiry

spec.rawSql:
WITH callbacks AS (
  SELECT
    h.id,
    h.created_at,
    h.fulfilled_at,
    h.expires_at,
    CASE
      WHEN h.expires_at <= NOW() THEN 'expired'
      ELSE h.status
    END AS state
  FROM oneoff_hooks h
)
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval), 'created' AS metric, COUNT(*)::double precision AS value
FROM callbacks
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(fulfilled_at, $__interval), 'fulfilled' AS metric, COUNT(*)::double precision AS value
FROM callbacks
WHERE fulfilled_at IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(fulfilled_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;

spec.description: Callbacks created and fulfilled per interval in the selected time range.
spec.title: Callbacks Created vs Fulfilled

spec.rawSql:
WITH callbacks AS (
  SELECT
    h.id,
    h.created_at,
    h.fulfilled_at,
    h.expires_at,
    CASE
      WHEN h.expires_at <= NOW() THEN 'expired'
      ELSE h.status
    END AS state
  FROM oneoff_hooks h
)
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(fulfilled_at, $__interval), 'avg' AS metric, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM fulfilled_at - created_at)) AS value
FROM callbacks
WHERE fulfilled_at IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(fulfilled_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(fulfilled_at, $__interval), 'max' AS metric, MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM fulfilled_at - created_at)) AS value
FROM callbacks
WHERE fulfilled_at IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(fulfilled_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;

spec.description: Average and maximum creation-to-fulfillment latency per interval.
spec.title: Time to Fulfill Over Time

spec.rawSql:
WITH callbacks AS (
  SELECT
    h.id,
    h.created_at,
    h.fulfilled_at,
    h.expires_at,
    CASE
      WHEN h.expires_at <= NOW() THEN 'expired'
      ELSE h.status
    END AS state
  FROM oneoff_hooks h
)
SELECT state, COUNT(*)::double precision AS callback_count
FROM callbacks
GROUP BY state
ORDER BY callback_count DESC;

spec.description: Stored callbacks grouped by effective state. Ignores the time range.
spec.title: Current State Breakdown

spec.rawSql:
WITH callbacks AS (
  SELECT
    h.id,
    h.created_at,
    h.fulfilled_at,
    h.expires_at,
    CASE
      WHEN h.expires_at <= NOW() THEN 'expired'
      ELSE h.status
    END AS state
  FROM oneoff_hooks h
)
SELECT bucket, COUNT(*)::double precision AS callback_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN NOW() - created_at < INTERVAL '1 minute' THEN '1. < 1m'
      WHEN NOW() - created_at < INTERVAL '1 hour' THEN '2. 1m-1h'
      WHEN NOW() - created_at < INTERVAL '1 day' THEN '3. 1h-1d'
      WHEN NOW() - created_at < INTERVAL '7 days' THEN '4. 1d-7d'
      ELSE '5. > 7d'
    END AS bucket
  FROM callbacks
  WHERE state = 'pending'
) b
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket;

spec.description: Pending callbacks bucketed by age. Ignores the time range.
spec.title: Pending Age Distribution

spec.rawSql:
WITH callbacks AS (
  SELECT
    h.id,
    h.created_at,
    h.fulfilled_at,
    h.expires_at,
    CASE
      WHEN h.expires_at <= NOW() THEN 'expired'
      ELSE h.status
    END AS state
  FROM oneoff_hooks h
)
SELECT bucket, COUNT(*)::double precision AS callback_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN fulfilled_at - created_at < INTERVAL '1 second' THEN '1. < 1s'
      WHEN fulfilled_at - created_at < INTERVAL '1 minute' THEN '2. 1s-1m'
      WHEN fulfilled_at - created_at < INTERVAL '1 hour' THEN '3. 1m-1h'
      WHEN fulfilled_at - created_at < INTERVAL '1 day' THEN '4. 1h-1d'
      ELSE '5. > 1d'
    END AS bucket
  FROM callbacks
  WHERE fulfilled_at IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(fulfilled_at)
) b
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket;

spec.description: Callbacks fulfilled in the selected time range bucketed by creation-to-fulfillment latency.
spec.title: Time to Fulfill Distribution

spec.rawSql:
WITH callbacks AS (
  SELECT
    h.id,
    h.created_at,
    h.fulfilled_at,
    h.expires_at,
    CASE
      WHEN h.expires_at <= NOW() THEN 'expired'
      ELSE h.status
    END AS state
  FROM oneoff_hooks h
)
SELECT id, created_at, expires_at,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - created_at) AS age_seconds,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM expires_at - NOW()) AS expires_in_seconds
FROM callbacks
WHERE state = 'pending'
ORDER BY created_at ASC
LIMIT 100;

spec.description: Longest-waiting pending callbacks. Ignores the time range.
spec.title: Oldest Pending Callbacks

spec.rawSql:
WITH callbacks AS (
  SELECT
    h.id,
    h.created_at,
    h.fulfilled_at,
    h.expires_at,
    CASE
      WHEN h.expires_at <= NOW() THEN 'expired'
      ELSE h.status
    END AS state
  FROM oneoff_hooks h
)
SELECT id, state, created_at, fulfilled_at, expires_at,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM fulfilled_at - created_at) AS time_to_fulfill_seconds
FROM callbacks
WHERE fulfilled_at IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(fulfilled_at)
ORDER BY fulfilled_at DESC
LIMIT 100;
